gap: No result ChatGPT got gives the kit-versus-parts price math for the top pick: on BLUETTI's US store on 2026-11-14 the Elite 30 V2 alone is $289.99, the 100W kit is $489.99 (so the panel adds $200), and the SP100L 100W panel alone is $249, so the kit saves $49 over buying the two separately.
standout_why: I compared against the three cited rival pages. solar-home.space prices only Anker SOLIX listings plus loose ALLPOWERS panels and has no BLUETTI Elite 30 V2. campequipmentplus.com shows no prices at all, only 'Check Latest Price on Amazon'. solutionenergy.com gives station-only October 2026 prices for EcoFlow and Goal Zero and no price for any small kit. None of them prices a 300 Wh-class kit against its parts or against the next size up.
decides: Confirms the BLUETTI Elite 30 V2 + 100W ($489.99, in stock) as the tent pick. It is the only kit we could price today in this 288 Wh, 600W class that you can actually buy: the ALLPOWERS VOLIX P300 + 100W ($216.99) and all ALLPOWERS R600 kits are sold out. Anker's own store charges $429.99 for the C300 with no panel. Shoppers who only need phones and lights can take the Elite 30 V2 + 60W kit for $399.99. Our page needs fixing: the BLUETTI AC180 + 100W (SP100L) row should read $679 and in stock today, not $649 and back late November. The AC180 kit gives 4× the battery for $189 more and suits car camping.

findings.label: Kit price, maker's US store
findings.note: Read with storecheck.py product, one variant, compare-at $489.99 (no markdown). The page also shows a Black Friday early-access offer (Nov 5–18) that applies only to orders of $2,000 or more, so it doesn't reach this kit, plus 5% off a first order for a newsletter signup.

findings.label: Station-only price, maker's US store
findings.source_title: BLUETTI Elite 30 V2 Portable Power Station | 600W 288Wh
findings.note: Kit minus station: $489.99 − $289.99 = $200 for the 100W panel inside the kit.

findings.label: Panel sold alone, maker's US store
findings.note: Separately: $289.99 + $249 = $538.99, against the $489.99 kit, so the kit saves $49. The kit page doesn't name its panel model, so this assumes the kit panel matches the SP100L.

findings.note: Station + SORA 60 bought separately ($289.99 + $129 = $418.99) costs $19 more than this kit. Loses to the 100W kit because the 60W panel takes longer to refill the 288 Wh battery.
